note: Comparison family of the final study, declared before the protocol freeze (hashed into it) and before any held-out run. Paired by case (same scenario, truncation, repeat and case id on both sides), percentile bootstrap of the mean difference (b - a), resampled within scenario, Holm-Bonferroni over the whole family. Metrics are per case: coverage_event_reachable (1/0 on reachable attack cases, the headline), citation_precision_event, unsupported_claim_rate (claims of the case), verdict_correct (1/0, all cases).

H2 verifier: single before vs after, unsupported claims
